what_this_is: The Workshop rows for tools/tours-screen: the workspace tours, the tours waiting to start by themselves as the person's show rules leave them, and dismissing waiting tours, over the person's own tour and progress records.

payload.label: List the workspace tours
payload.job: Show me every tour in my workspace and which ones I have finished
payload.description: Given the tours your AIs wrote (own_tours, the value of guided-overlay::own-walkthroughs) and your tour progress (progress), both read from the store that holds them, and the app's own tours when the caller passes them as tours, answers each tour in its order: tour_id, title, summary, steps, finished, the event that starts it by name (start_event), when the change it shows landed (changed_at) and whether it is one of your own. It changes and keeps nothing.

tours.description: The app's own tours (walkthrough definitions), when the caller has them

own_tours.description: The tours your AIs wrote: the value of your record guided-overlay::own-walkthroughs, read from the store that holds it; leave out when you have none

progress.description: Your tour progress: the value of your record guided-overlay::walkthrough-progress, read from the store that holds it; leave out when you have none

provenance.source: trillion tools/guided-overlay (tag old-trillion-before-worker-retire b6ae0ebf81; here tools/tours-screen) show/walkthroughs.ts listWalkthroughs, waitingWalkthroughs and dismissWalkthroughs over the moved folds read-data/walkthrough-eeaf.ts, engine/trigger-intake.ts and do-work/walkthrough-progress.ts applyProgressTransition; the labels are src/tours.json, moved byte for byte as read-data/tours.json; holds are the person's show-rules record by tools/set-up-my-account showDecision Keeps nothing and has no records door: own_tours, progress and show_rules come in the request (w7-tools-keep-nothing).

payload.label: List the tours waiting to show
payload.job: Show me the tours waiting to start by themselves, and which my show rules are holding
payload.description: Every tour that would start by itself on an event (opening Trillion, by default), with the facts your show rules decide it over (reason, urgency, hours since one like it) and how your show-rules record leaves it now: held, the rules holding it (held_by) and until when. The same trigger choice, facts and rules the tour host asks before it starts one, so this list and what shows agree. Give own_tours, progress and show_rules (the values of your tour records and your show-rules record, read from the store that holds them; each left out when you have none). It changes and keeps nothing.

payload.label: Dismiss waiting tours
payload.job: Dismiss the tours waiting for me without showing them
payload.description: Marks waiting tours seen without showing them: every waiting tour, or those named in tour_ids, in one move of your tour progress record (the move closing a tour makes), so none starts by itself again; each can still be shown by name. Give own_tours, progress and show_rules as for list-waiting-tours. Nothing is written here: it answers keep, the progress record it would write with the progress you gave as expected, for you to keep in the store that holds it; a record changed meanwhile is not written over.
